title: My Roommate Texted Me That There's a Goose in Our Bathtub #shorts #textstory
description:
I brought home a goose. My roommate was not ready. Our landlord was even less ready.

Follow for new stories every day.

#textstory #shorts #funnytexts #funny

messages.text: Why is there a goose in our bathtub?
He followed me home from the park.
He hissed at me. I'm hiding in the hallway.
He's shy. Give him some lettuce.
The landlord comes at noon for the inspection.
Gerald is HIS goose. Missing for a week.
messages.say: Gerald is his goose. He's been missing for a week.
He's taking a hundred off our rent.

messages.text: And he wants you to goose-sit on weekends. Paid.

end: I'm a professional goose sitter now. Gerald still hates my roommate.
